verdict.rationale: Sierra shows that agent-to-human hand-off exists, since its docs mention configurable 'hand-off rules' (sierra-docs-29). Live Assist guides care reps while 'automatically capturing and updating customer context' with 'no lost context' (sierra-docs-14, sierra-docs-15). That is adjacent to, but not explicit evidence of, a handoff package that gives the human agent the transcript, a summary and the collected details. missing for 10: documented transfer of the full conversation transcript on escalation, an auto-generated handoff summary, structured passing of collected customer details to the human agent, integration with helpdesk/agent desktops, independent or hands-on corroboration that customers don't repeat themselves.
